title: Bank Return Period Hold on Check Deposits When a CEP Refund Is Made (School Nutrition Services Meal Account)
content:
On a School Nutrition Services Meal Account, check deposits still inside the bank's return period for a check stay on the account: when the account shows a returned deposit in the twelve months before the refund date and check deposits in the two months before it, those check deposits of the two months stay; when it shows no returned deposit in that period and check deposits in the month before the refund date, those check deposits of the month stay; otherwise none stay.

A date falls within the N months before the refund date when fewer than N whole calendar months separate it from the refund date, a whole month being reached on the same day of a later month or, when that later month has no such day, on the first day of the month after it.

| Returned deposit in the 12 months before the refund date | Check deposits in the 2 months before it | Check deposits in the 1 month before it | What stays |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | any | the check deposits of the two months |
| yes | none | none | nothing |
| none | any | yes | the check deposits of the month |
| none | any | none | nothing |

## Worked case

Hypothetical: a refund date of February 9, 2027 on an account with check deposits of 25.00 on January 20 and 30.00 on December 18, 2026. With no returned deposit in the twelve months before that date, only the January deposit falls within the month before, so 25.00 stays. With a returned deposit in that twelve-month period, both fall within the two months before, so 55.00 stays.
